About MasterCraft In Long Island City

MasterCraft Auto Repair & Collision is based at 38-21 23rd Street in Long Island City, Queens. Owner Syed Bukhari brings over 30 years of experience in collision and mechanical repair to the shop.

Call (718) 578-4563

Personal attention from estimate to inspection

Our work brings collision restoration, mechanical repairs, body and paint, and insurance claim coordination together at one location. Syed takes a personal look at the work, from the first estimate to the final inspection.

Experience and technician qualifications

The shop has certified technicians. Ask us about the current technician qualifications relevant to your vehicle and repair when discussing the work with our team.

Visit the shop

We are open daily from 6 AM to midnight. Drivers visiting from Queens, Brooklyn, or elsewhere in New York City can call to discuss their vehicle and arrange a visit to our Long Island City location.
